newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican industrial chamber sees '97 GDP at 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexican industrial chamber sees '97 GDP at 4.5 pct.

text.p: The president of leading Mexican business group, the National Confederation of Industrial Chambers (Concamin), forecast a 4.5 percent increase in gross domestic product in 1997.
"We expect it (GDP growth) will be about 4.5 percent, with inflation in the order of 17 percent," Victor Manuel Diaz Romero told reporters om Monday.
Mexican government officials have estimated at least a four percent increase in GDP in 1997, and inflation reaching 15 percent.
Last year, the GDP grew about 4.5 percent, according to Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz.
Diaz Romero forecast average interest rates for the year at about 21 percent.
